title: AARO historical report misstated Michael Herrera's testimony

tellings.quote: One specific specific example we know for a fact that was lied about in Arrow historical report volume one was Michael Herrera's testimony.

plain: The Pentagon's 2024 historical report on UFOs, Volume 1 of the review by AARO (the Pentagon office set up to investigate unidentified aerial reports), is said to have misrepresented what a witness named Michael Herrera told investigators. An online researcher who goes by UAPGerb tells Michels it is "one specific example we know for a fact" was "lied about" in the report, setting the report beside Herrera's own memorandum for the record of his account and naming Sean Kirkpatrick, who led the office. If so, it would mean the government's official history of the subject cannot be taken at its word.
